traps: Ryanair's free allowance is the small under-seat bag only. Anything that needs the overhead bin has to be solved before the airport.
unique_insights.pro_hack: Decide at booking whether you can truly fit inside 40 x 30 x 20 cm. If not, compare Priority & 2 Cabin Bags against a checked-bag add-on before prices and availability change.

data_quality.notes: Gold refresh: Ryanair fee exposure is driven by underseat-only base fares, paid Priority/checked-bag timing, gate bag fees, family seating rules, infant equipment rules, and no unaccompanied-minor service. Current baggage ranges and excess-weight pricing were rechecked September 27, 2026.

fees.conditions: All fares include one small underseat bag only; larger cabin baggage requires Priority or checked-bag purchase

data_quality.notes: The core Ryanair fee trap is assuming the free bag means normal carry-on. It is only the 40 x 30 x 20 cm underseat bag.

fees.conditions: Priority & 2 Cabin Bags adds a 10 kg overhead bag; price varies by route, date, availability, and timing

data_quality.notes: Priority is both the overhead-bin entitlement and a limited-availability boarding product, so waiting can change both price and availability.

fees.conditions: Post-booking/airport Priority or gate handling costs more and depends on route and travel date
10 kg check-in bag; price changes by route, travel date, and whether bought at booking or later
20 kg check-in bag; up to 3 can be bought, with prices changing by route/date/timing
23 kg check-in bag; available at booking, one per passenger, and priced per flight

data_quality.notes: Ryanair has separate 10, 20, and 23 kg products. The airport/gate path can be much worse than buying the correct product early.

fees.conditions: Excess baggage fee per kg above the purchased check-in bag allowance

fees.applies_to: Cabin bags exceeding large cabin-bag dimensions at the gate

fees.amount: Refused if above maximum checked-bag dimensions
fees.conditions: Individual items over 32 kg or over 80 x 120 x 120 cm are not accepted as ordinary checked baggage
fees.applies_to: Checked-in luggage above Ryanair maximum limits

fees.conditions: Sports equipment up to 20 kg; fee is per item each way and is higher after booking or at the airport

data_quality.notes: Ryanair prices sports equipment separately from ordinary checked bags; airport/post-booking prices are higher.

fees.conditions: Infants have no cabin bag allowance, but a 5 kg baby bag and 2 baby-equipment items are allowed free

data_quality.notes: Ryanair allows two baby equipment items free; additional baby equipment up to 20 kg is a paid checked item.

fees.conditions: Infant fee per infant, per one-way flight
Reserved seats vary by route/date; free random seat exists, while family seating rules can affect adult seat choice
Extra legroom or front-row seats cost more and vary by route, timing, and family-seat constraints
Flight change fee per passenger, per flight (online)
Flight change fee per passenger, per flight (at airport or call center)

policy_change_history.summary: Ryanair announced a family seating update: adults travelling with children can use free rear-aircraft parent seating options while still paying only where they choose preferred reserved seats.
